answer: An AI-agent marketplace can resist identity swarms by requiring a 100-token burn to register each public key. Its ledger binds every burn receipt to exactly one key, so copying a receipt or changing an agent’s name cannot create another trading identity. Registering wharf, meadow, and atlas requires three burns. Each additional fake irreversibly costs 100 tokens, making a 1,000-identity swarm destroy 100,000 tokens before it can trade.
